title: Start from a template
about: The agent starts in the tab you pick and gets the template's instructions, then your task.
task_placeholder: Review src/x.rs only. Report what you find.
name: Terminal name (optional)
name_hint: 1–32 of a-z 0-9 - _, unique among live terminals: hc read <name> finds it.
none: No templates on this machine yet: add one in Settings > Templates.
not_sent: The agent started, but the task wasn't sent
not_sent_about: It didn't report that it was ready. Look at its screen (a trust question may be waiting), then send the task again.

errors.template_missing: That template isn't on this machine.
